nav.title: AI Kɔnɛktisɔn Sɛntɛr
nav.subtitle: Ka bɔ ɔ laadalabaga kɛ kanw kunnafoniw la.

stats.providerQualificationNote: Kanw dɔrɔn dɔgɔkun baaralenw bɛ jirali

customer.title: Baro daminɛ
customer.consentText: N bɛ sɔn ko nin baro bɛ se ka baara ni AI sɔnnen. Kunnafoniw bɛ dogo sani u mara.
customer.setupHint: Filɛ dɔnkili ja bilemɔ ani AI baarakɛla ma.
customer.chatEmpty: Kunnafoniw bɛ jigin yan. AI baarakɛliw ye ladilikan dɔrɔn; warima, jɔyɔrɔ cɛ, saralali, ɔn
customer.voiceStreamNote: Kanw bɛ ci baarakɛla fɛ; OpsCore tɛ a ɲɔgɔn bayɛ k'a kanw mara.
customer.voiceRequirement: Kanw baro b'a fɛ HTTPS, mikiro, yidɛli, Realtime ani baarakɛla kɔdi. A tɛ tɛliyɔn jɔyɔrɔ ye.

queue.title: Danmafɔli jɔyɔrɔ
queue.description: Barow naga baalia, ma baro, walima hadam bila; o bɛ jigin yan. Jɔyɔrɔ kɔni bila la, tɛ kɔnɛktisɔn ye.
queue.empty: Hadam bila tɛ nin jɛkulu kɔnɔ.
queue.replyStorageNote: Hadamw ka jaabaw tɛ mara sani u ye baro kɔnɔ fili.
queue.resolveNote: Hadamw ka baarakɛla ye a dabila.

boundaries.title: Baara danw
boundaries.automateBody: Kɔnɔmabaga jiɲɛ, ɲɔgɔn kunnafoni, farati jɛ, kunnafoni mara, kamalen woloma.
boundaries.humanBody: Hadam bila, dan ko, farati belebele, sariya tɛ, kunnafoni tɛ, kunnafoni dogolen.
boundaries.notEnabledTitle: Nin kanw dɔrɔn tɛ se k'a baara
boundaries.notEnabledBody: PSTN/SIP, WhatsApp, imel, tɛliyɔn jɔyɔrɔ, CRM ani kanw jo ka ɲɛw baarakɛla kɔdiw ani sɛgɛsɛgɛli la.

messages.qualificationNotice: Kan si tɛ dɔnbali ma fɔ sani kan, ASR, TTS ani baro sɛgɛsɛgɛli ma kɛ.
messages.configOk: Labɛn bɛ yen. Baarakɛla jɔyɔrɔ ani kan ɲɛman bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli la.
messages.conversationCreated: Baro bolokilen dilanna. Kan ɲɛman ma dɔn.
messages.handoffQueued: Hadam bila jɔyɔrɔ ({reason}). Nin ye jɔyɔrɔ bila ye, tɛ kɔnɛktisɔn ye.
messages.aiResponseFailed: AI jaabi ma dafa. Baara si ma kɛ. I bɛ se ka hadam bila.
messages.apiUnavailable: API ma se ka jigin. I ka dɔn OpsCore kɔnɔ, o kɔ i ka nin ɲɛ segin.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Hadam bila jɔyɔrɔ ({reason}). Jɔyɔrɔ ma yira ko baarakɛla bɛ yen.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Hadam bila jɔyɔrɔ. AI baro bɛ jɔ; tɛliyɔn jɔyɔrɔ ma labɛn.
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Realtime baarakɛla ye fili yira. Kanw baro jɔ, labɛn lajɛ, o kɔ i ka segin.
messages.voiceActive: Kanw baro bɛ baara la. Hadam bila waati o waati; a bɛ jɔyɔrɔ dilan, tɛ tɛliyɔn ye.

errors.SERVER_RESPONSE_INVALID: Server jaabi man se ka kalan.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: Nin browser tɛ se ka Realtime kanw baara.
